import { type ConfigPlugin, withPodfile } from 'expo/config-plugins';

const POD_MINIMUM = `
    installer.pods_project.targets.each do |pod_target|
      pod_target.build_configurations.each do |configuration|
        minimum = configuration.build_settings['IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET']
        if minimum && Gem::Version.new(minimum) < Gem::Version.new('15.0')
          configuration.build_settings['IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET'] = '15.0'
        end
      end
    end
`;

export function addXcode27PodMinimum(contents: string): string {
  const postInstall = /^    react_native_post_install\([\s\S]*?^    \)\r?\n/gm;
  const matches = [...contents.matchAll(postInstall)];
  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error('Cannot locate React Native post-install in the iOS Podfile');
  }
  if (contents.includes(POD_MINIMUM)) return contents;
  if (contents.includes('installer.pods_project.targets.each do |pod_target|')) {
    throw new Error('Unexpected existing Pod deployment minimum hook');
  }
  return contents.replace(postInstall, `$&${POD_MINIMUM}`);
}

const withXcode27PodMinimum: ConfigPlugin = (config) =>
  withPodfile(config, (podfile) => {
    podfile.modResults.contents = addXcode27PodMinimum(podfile.modResults.contents);
    return podfile;
  });

export default withXcode27PodMinimum;
